note: Reference tools this project neither ships nor downloads. Supply each one yourself, legally obtained, in the gitignored external/ folder. Identify what you place there by its filename and every value in accepted: size in bytes plus CRC32, MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256. sha256 decides accept or reject; the rest identify and cross-check. No download location is recorded here, by design. CI and the gate suite never use these; they drive the optional local interop cross-checks only.
